title: 第19章 擂台争锋轻取对手第20章 脱离杂役入驻外门
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 演武场上气氛骤然凝重起来。
第二轮功法演武尘埃落定，留下来的弟子已然寥寥无几。
能闯到最后一轮擂台对决的，全是炼气三层里根基扎实、招式娴熟的精锐。
每个人眼中都带着紧张，也藏着一丝不甘平庸的野心。
高台之上，白发长老端坐正中，神色威严肃穆。
两侧执事各司其职，开始安排擂台对战次序。
广场中央的青石擂台宽阔平整，四周以低矮石栏围起。
擂台之上分胜负，决高低，定去留。
按照宗门规矩，擂台比试点到为止，不可蓄意重创，不可痛下杀手。
若是主动认输、被打下擂台、或是失去再战之力，皆判落败。
胜者直接入选外门，败者只要表现尚可，也有酌情收录的机会。
对于所有参赛者而言，这最后一轮，既是考验实力，也是博取机缘的最后机会。
观礼石阶上，外门与内门弟子纷纷坐直身子。
比起前两轮死板的核验与演武，擂台厮杀才最有看头。
拳脚交锋，灵气碰撞，临场应变，心性比拼，全都能一眼看得通透。
不少人目光扫过下方人群，暗自留意那些气息沉稳、身形凝练的年轻修士。
想要看看这批新晋弟子里，能否冒出几个可塑之才。
执事拿着名册，当众宣读对战排序。
一名名弟子被念到名字，依次登台对阵。
很快，第一场擂台比试正式开启。
两名年纪相仿的少年纵身跃上台面，彼此躬身行礼过后，立刻出手交锋。
拳掌交错，灵力激荡，招式你来我往，攻守互换。
都是青岚宗基础拳脚，却打出了截然不同的水准。
有人出手勇猛刚烈，直来直往。
有人身法灵巧，游走周旋，伺机反击。
台下众人目光齐聚擂台，看得目不暇接。
片刻交手过后，其中一人招式露出破绽，被对手一掌震退数步。
心知不敌，只能拱手认输。
执事当场宣判，登台者胜，顺利入选外门。
落败者虽有遗憾，但神色坦然，默默退到场边等候评判。
一场又一场比试接连上演。
擂台上拳脚破空之声不绝，灵力起伏荡漾。
有势均力敌缠斗许久才分胜负，也有实力悬殊，数招之内便定输赢。
不少平日里在后山自视甚高的杂役弟子，一上擂台便显出底蕴不足。
临场应变欠缺，搏杀经验浅薄，没过几招便败下阵来。
赵虎也被念到名字，纵身跃上擂台。
他对手是一名来自山脚散修的少年，修为同样稳固在炼气三层。
两人甫一交手，便打得格外激烈。
赵虎依仗常年劳作练就的强悍体魄，拳势刚猛，步步紧逼。
对手身法灵活，不断游走闪避，伺机偷袭。
你来我往缠斗数十回合，赵虎凭借扎实根基与蛮力压制，抓住对方破绽，一拳震退对手。
content_en:
The atmosphere in the martial arts arena suddenly became tense.
The dust of the second round of martial arts training has settled, and there are only a few disciples left.
Those who can make it to the final round of the arena showdown are all elites from the third level of Qi Refining who have a solid foundation and are skilled in moves.
There is tension in everyone's eyes, and there is also a trace of ambition that is unwilling to be mediocre.
On the high platform, the white-haired elder sat in the middle, looking majestic and solemn.
The deacons on both sides performed their duties and began to arrange the order of the battle in the arena.
The bluestone arena in the center of the square is wide and flat, surrounded by low stone fences.
In the arena, the winner is decided, the winner is determined, the winner is decided, the winner is determined to stay or go.
According to the sect's rules, until the competition in the arena is over, no serious injuries are allowed on purpose, and no killing is allowed.
If you voluntarily admit defeat, are kicked off the ring, or lose the ability to fight again, you will be deemed a loser.
The winner will be directly selected into the outer sect, while the loser will also have the opportunity to be included as long as his performance is acceptable.
For all contestants, this final round is not only a test of strength, but also the last chance to win opportunities.
On the stone steps to observe the ceremony, the outer and inner disciples sat upright one after another.
Compared with the rigid verification and martial arts performances in the first two rounds, the fighting in the arena is the most interesting.
The fight of fists and feet, the collision of spiritual energy, the on-the-spot response, and the competition of hearts and minds, all can be seen clearly at a glance.
Many people glanced at the crowd below, secretly paying attention to the young monks with calm auras and concise figures.
I want to see if there are some malleable talents among these new disciples.
The deacon took the roster and read out the battle order in front of everyone.
The names of the disciples were read one by one, and they took the stage to compete one by one.
Soon, the first arena competition officially began.
Two young men of similar age jumped onto the stage, bowed to each other, and then immediately started fighting.
Fists and palms interlock, spiritual power surges, moves come and go, offense and defense exchange.
They are both basic fists and kicks from the Qinglan Sect, but they perform at completely different levels.
Some people take action bravely and vigorously, and go straight forward.
Some people are dexterous in their physical skills, moving around and waiting for opportunities to counterattack.
The eyes of everyone in the audience were all focused on the ring, and they were dazzled.
After a moment of fighting, one of them showed a flaw in his moves and was knocked back several steps by his opponent's palm.
Knowing that he is outmatched, he can only surrender.
The deacon pronounced the verdict on the spot, and the one who took the stage won and was successfully selected for the outer door.
Although the loser had regrets, he looked calm and quietly retreated to the sidelines to wait for the judge.
One competition after another took place.
On the ring, the sound of punches and kicks punching through the air was endless, and the spiritual power was rippling.
There are evenly matched opponents who fight for a long time before deciding the winner, and there are also situations where the strength is so disparate that the winner or loser can be determined within a few moves.
Many handyman disciples who usually think very highly of themselves in the back mountains show their lack of background once they enter the ring.
He lacked on-the-spot response and had little fighting experience, so he was defeated in just a few moves.
Zhao Hu's name was also read and he jumped onto the ring.
His opponent was a young man from the foot of the mountain who was a casual cultivator, and his cultivation was also firmly at the third level of Qi refining.
As soon as the two of them fought, they fought extremely fiercely.
Zhao Hu relies on his strong physique developed through years of hard work, and his punches are fierce and he presses forward step by step.
The opponent's movements are flexible and he constantly moves and dodges, waiting for opportunities to sneak attacks.
You and I fought for dozens of rounds. Zhao Hu relied on his solid foundation and brute force to suppress, seize the opponent's weakness, and knock back the opponent with one punch.
title_en: Chapter 19: Fighting in the ring and defeating the opponent easily Chapter 20: Breaking away from the handymen and settling in the outer gate
